newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Amer's 1996 seen in the red.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Amer's 1996 seen in the red.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 205 million markka median forecast full-year 1996 loss before extraordinary items and tax for Finnish sporting goods manufacturer Amer-yhtyma Oy.
(Fourteen of the 15 analysts forecast a loss. All 13 analysts who also gave EPS forecasts predicted a full-year 1996 loss per share).
Amer's 1996 results are due on February 13 in the afternoon.
In 1995, Amer had a 75 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 10 of the 15 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 16 million markka (mean 7 million) ranging from a 46 million markka loss to a 40 million markka profit.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Opstock, Postipankki and S-E Banken.
